    "category": "Authentication",
    "title": "Authentication decorator fails open after catching its own 401",
    "description": "require_auth catches Exception around abort(401), clears g.user, and then calls the protected view instead of re-raising or returning an error. Consequently every endpoint using this decorator can be reached without a valid bearer token; views that do not dereference g.user execute as an anonymous caller, while others may produce a server error.",
    "evidence": "GET /orders/1 with no Authorization header returned HTTP 200 and the order contents. The failing path is require_auth -> abort(401) -> broad except -> f(*args, **kwargs), and orders.show_order calls get_order() without an ownership check."
  },
